nate: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need two small playbook updates + clear owners so we can close action items. Assigning below.

rachel: I'll take the runbook triage checklist (short TL;DR + commands). Target PR Wed. Will add a one-line "when to page" box.

jin: I'll add the fallback routing steps + add exact admin API calls. Also will include a short note about verifying KV hit-rate after rollback. PR by Thu.

ben-sre: I'll create the PagerDuty escalation snippet and map roles to PD services. Also propose a 30-min exec notify threshold.

nate: Proposed paging thresholds: p95 up >10% for 10m OR error_rate >1% for 5m. If agreed I'll add to runbook.

jin: +1 on thresholds. Example quick-collect commands I'll add:
```bash
# snapshot metrics
curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8080/metrics | tail -n 40
# model cache summary
redis-cli -u redis://redis-main:6379 HGETALL model_cache_summary
```

ops-bot: Created issue RW-INC-4901: "playbook runbook edits - triage & escalation". Assigned rachel, jin, ben-sre. Due 2026-04-05.

nate: Final owners/dates: rachel (triage checklist, PR Wed 2026-03-31), jin (fallback + verify steps, PR Thu 2026-04-02), ben-sre (PD mapping, PR Thu). Sync Fri 09:30 to review. Add blockers here. :thumbsup:
